verdict.rationale: gstack's skills (ship, QA, review, autoplan) are triggered within an AI coding agent session (Claude Code, etc.) rather than as autonomous background automations that run on schedules or triggers without user invocation; community discussion even flags concern about agents 'running autonomously across your repos' but no evidence shows scheduled/background/unattended automation setup. missing for 10: no scheduler/cron/trigger mechanism, no evidence of unattended background execution independent of an active coding session.
